pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are irregularly polygonal with sharp, crenulated edges exhibiting high-contrast pixel gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the upper neck and shoulder regions, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower flank and ventral surface.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected lattice. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor pixel thickness is maximal on the upper neck and tapers into finer, more intricate pathways across the lower flank and hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette with low-amplitude vertical hair projections. The contour is densely packed and relatively uniform in height along the visible neck segment against the sky background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (Buphagus sp.) perched on the posterior dorsal ridge near the rump, creating a localized silhouette disruption.
